text:
Anya: quick thought — propose we introduce lightweight interface gateways around 3 high-risk modules (ingest, cache, enrich) and run a 6-week paydown sprint. fences = simple grpc/proxy adapters, not full rewrite. feedback? :thinking:
Leo: +1. How does this interact with session-mesh split? we don't want duplicated routing layers.
Tess: prefer incremental: gateway per module with feature-flagged adapter. rollouts: canary by tenant -> 0.5%, 5%, 25%, 100%. keep old path for 2 weeks.
Mike: what's the definition of "paydown" here? remove duplicated code? decouple ownership? measurable goals please.
Anya: PR goals: (1) extract public interface + tests, (2) move consumer code to adapter, (3) delete legacy path. success = <10% cross-service imports + instrumented latency no-regress.
Leo: ok - metrics: we'll need token-level cost, p99 latency, error-rate, and deploy-age bucket. suggest we add span tags: module.gateway, adapter.version.
Tess: ops runbook note: rollback plan -> feature-flag off, traffic-shift back, quick DB schema compatibility check. also need runbook snippet.
Anya: runbook snippet:
```
if gateway.error_rate > 1% or p99_latency_increase > 30%:
  toggle feature_flag off
  revert canary deployment
  notify #eng-oncall
```
Anya: timeline proposal: week1 spec & tests, week2 spike + infra, weeks3-4 adapters + canary, week5 cleanup + deletions, week6 follow-up + metrics sweep. :rocket: 
Mike: can we chunk by teams? ingest = infra, cache = runtime, enrich = ml. each team owns their gateway & paydown. aligns with squads.
Leo: one more: for backwards compat, gateway should support dual-path header `X-Use-Gateway: true|false` for testing.
Tess: I'll draft RFC update and include the runbook + gating metrics. expect a doc in #architecture later today.
deploy-bot: Deployed canary: gateway/ingest v1.0 -> 0.5% traffic at 3112345710
Anya: thanks all — small steps, observable gates. will post follow-up with RFC link. :thumbsup:
